description: In a major push towards infrastructure expansion, digital governance, industrial growth and public service modernisation, the Bihar Cabinet chaired by Chief Minister has approved around 20 major decisions aimed at accelerating the state’s long-term development roadmap.
body_lead: In a major push towards infrastructure expansion, digital governance, industrial growth and public service modernisation, the Bihar Cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister, has approved around 20 major decisions aimed at accelerating the state’s long-term development roadmap. The decisions span key sectors including transport, artificial intelligence, roads, urban development, education, judiciary and river protection.
